程序包 TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.model

类 Position

java.lang.Object
TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.model.Position
public class Position extends Object
Represents a job position for Teaching Assistant (TA) recruitment.

This entity stores all information about a TA position including job details, requirements, application deadline, and hiring status. Positions are created by Module Organizers (MO) or administrators through the MOPublishService.

Position lifecycle:

  1. Created with PositionStatus.OPEN status
  2. TAs can apply while position is OPEN and deadline has not passed
  3. Position can be manually closed by the MO, changing status to PositionStatus.CLOSED
  4. Position automatically expires when deadline passes, changing status to PositionStatus.EXPIRED

Key fields:

  • grade: Target student grade (e.g., "Year 2", "All Grades")
  • major: Target major (e.g., "Computer Science", "All majors")
  • jobType: Job category (e.g., "Grading", "Lab Support")
  • headcount: Number of TAs to hire (used for auto-closing when filled)
  • responsibleMO: Name of the MO responsible for this position
